Older versions and changelogs

Description

This mod adds a customizable radial menu for your campaign abilities.
The vanilla ability bar was clearly not intended to hold more than 10 abilities. If you are playing with mods that add abilities this mod is a godsend.
The muscle memory from other games kicks in within about 5 seconds of use.

Supports both click-to-choose and relative positional selection (like in console games!).

Hold left Alt, B or right Ctrl on the campaign map, move onto an ability and release to use it. Release in the center or press Escape to cancel.
Hold left-click on a slot for half a second to assign an ability, clear the slot or create a submenu. I didn't use L-ctrl because it's used by console commands.

Your layout is shared across saves & campaigns.
Hotkeys (a mouse button works too), slot counts, labels, tile tint, tooltips and animations can be changed in LunaLib's mod settings.

In Use

FAQ
How do I open the menu?
Hold B, left Alt or right Ctrl on the campaign map. Move the cursor onto an ability and release the key to use it.

How do I cancel?
Move the cursor back to the center before releasing, or press Escape.

How do I change what is on the wheel?
Hold left-click on a slot for half a second. A menu opens where you can assign an ability, clear the slot or turn it into a submenu.

What are submenus?
A submenu groups more abilities behind a single slot. Hover over it and move outward to reach its abilities. Each submenu can have its own icon and colour.

How many slots can I have?
Up to 10 on the main wheel and up to 10 in each submenu. The defaults are 7 and 5, change them in LunaLib's mod settings.

Can I change the hotkeys?
Yes, in LunaLib's mod settings. There are three hotkeys and an optional mouse button (Middle, Mouse 4 or Mouse 5). Click a keybind and press Escape to clear it.

Does the game keep running while the menu is open?
No, the game pauses while the wheel is open. Turn off "Pause while open" in the settings if you want it to keep running.

Does it work with modded abilities?
Yes. Any ability your fleet has can be assigned to a slot.

Why is a tile grey or glowing?
Grey abilities can't be used right now. Active abilities glow, and abilities on cooldown show it on their tile.

Can I see what an ability does?
Hover over it to see its tooltip.

Do I have to set this up for every new save game?
No, your layout is shared across all campaigns. This means you can start a new save and do not have to set it up again. If you do not know an ability in that save yet, it'll show up in the spot it used to be assigned to when it is learned unless you overwrote the slot with a different ability.
